evidence: The PEALD-grown IGZO TFTs with a cycle [InO x × n cycle – ZnO × 1 cycle – GaO x × 1 cycle] exhibit excellent performances such as saturation mobilities of ~74 cm 2/Vs, threshold voltage of -1.3 V, on/off ratio of 8.910 8, subthreshold swing of 0.26 V/decade and hysteresis of 0.2 V, while keeping a reasonable carrier density of ~10 17 cm -3.
